thread:
maria: quick q — thinking about adding SLA-presets to the auto-fallback policy UX. want to brainstorm tradeoffs before i mock the console flow
jon: fwiw, what do you mean by SLA-presets? like canned fallback behaviors?
sam: yeah, e.g. presets = {aggressive, balanced, conservative} that map to error thresholds + fallback target models + sample rates
lee: would want telemetry surfaced for each preset — estimated p99 delta, cost uplift, and how many requests would hit fallback historically
maria: exactly. idea is: user picks a preset, we show an impact preview based on recent traffic + error signals, then they can tweak TTL/override
ashley: preview is 👏 needs to include audit footprint. who approved, change diff, and a compact playback link for request traces
jon: operator overrides are tricky — we need sticky vs ephemeral overrides. sticky requires an audit entry + reason. ephemeral should auto-expire and not require a full review
sam: agree. also we need a console affordance for blacklisting fallback targets for a rollout (some customers want certain cheaper models not used for fallback)
lee: telemetry-wise we should attach a sampling tag to fallback events, e.g. sampling_rate=0.01, and surface sampled traces in the playback UI
maria: rough UI idea: dropdown for preset, impact card with small charts, a sample-rate slider, and an "operator override" checkbox that opens a reason field
jon: +1. for audit we should store: who, preset_id, diff, sampling_policy, expiry_ts. keep it immutable and linkable from traces
sam: proto config we talked about earlier could look like: ```json
{"policy_name":"fallback_v2","preset":"aggressive","error_threshold":0.05,"fallback_target":"gpt-lite-quant","sample_rate":0.01,"override_expires":3600}
```
ashley: love that. one more: add a "circuit-watch" flag so we only escalate to full fallback when both error rate AND latency spike conditions met (reduces noisy fallbacks)
lee: +1. that reduces false positives. but it complicates preview sim — preview should be able to toggle single-signal vs conjunctive-signal mode
maria: operational question: who do we let toggle preset defaults org-wide? product owners? org admins? needs RBAC mapping
jon: org admins or billing owners probably. but allow route-level pinning so product teams can opt-out of org defaults
sam: also consider an API to apply presets (infra teams will want to do infra-as-code): /policies/:id/apply-preset POST {preset:"conservative", note:"experiment-42"}
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag auto-fallback-presets rolled out to staging (ff: fallback_presets_v1)
lee: nice — please add a telemetry event for "preset_preview_shown" and "preset_applied" with preset_id and estimated_impact fields
maria: ok next steps: i'll sketch a compact mock with the preview cards + sampling slider and the audit summary. can someone add API shape for apply-preset? sam?
sam: on it. i'll draft an endpoint + example payload by EOD and post here
jon: I'll write a short RFC for RBAC and override TTLs so we can discuss with security
ashley: i'll own the playback/audit UX bits and wire them into evals team for regression tests
maria: thanks all. quick followup: can we target a mini-proto in staging next week? if so we'll get early operator feedback
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled for 2024-04-02T03:00:00Z — includes feature flag fallback_presets_v1
maria: sweet — posting the mock later today, ping me for review :thumbsup:
